Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site (experian.com/careers) to understand why.

This role will support the experience of our flagship fraud platform – Ascend Fraud – supporting hundreds of clients, including the largest financial institutions in the world.

This is an ideal opportunity for a Product Manager with expertise in identity verification, analytics, fraud detection, and / or AI-driven decisioning. The successful candidate will be an AI-native product manager and own product responsibility for the Ascend Fraud platform user experience— from strategy and discovery through roadmap execution, delivery, and market adoption — while unlocking market opportunities, platform synergies, and a clear path for migration to new services.

**Product Strategy & Globalization**

* Work alongside regional stakeholders to drive roadmap and ensure Ascend Fraud (CrossCore) experience and platform priorities support regional goals
* Drive future-state requirements, feature parity, and long-term migration plans in line with the long term Ascend Fraud and Ascend platform strategy

**Product Discovery & Customer Insights**

* Work with customers and regional stakeholders to understand and address fraud and identity challenges across use cases
* Translate insights and usage data into product features that address clients' jobs-to-be-done

**Roadmap Execution**

* Own and deliver a roadmap for Ascend Fraud solutions across regions, with
* "full-stack" accountability from requirements through release for the client-facing user experience, including UI
* Using AI-DLC processes and tools, create standardized features, capabilities and reusable components

**Cross-Functional Leadership**

* Collaborate with globally distributed teams across Product, Engineering, Architecture, and Delivery
* Work closely with global and regional teams to ensure alignment with strategic priorities
* You will be reporting to the VP of Product Managemnt

  
**Qualifications**  

* 5+ years of Product Manager and/or Product Owner experience in complex, matrixed organizations,

* Prior ownership of B2B user experience, including UI in SaaS environment
* Domain expertise in Identity Verification, Fraud Detection, or Risk platforms
* Experience contributing to globally distributed products and platforms
* Drive product work in a geographically distributed environment
* Experience in AI-DLC environments and use of AI tools to drive feature collaboration and accelerated product and value delivery

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

You enjoy shaping the future of product innovation as a core leader, driving value for customers, guiding successful launches, and exceeding expectations. Join our dynamic team and make a meaningful impact by delivering high-quality products that resonate with clients.

As a Product Manager in Consumer and community banking, you are an integral part of the team that innovates new product offerings and leads the end-to-end product life cycle. As a core leader, you are responsible for acting as the voice of the customer and developing profitable products that provide customer value. Utilizing your deep understanding of how to get a product off the ground, you guide the successful launch of products, gather crucial feedback, and ensure top-tier client experiences. With a strong commitment to scalability, resiliency, and stability, you collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality products that exceed customer expectations.

  

Job Responsibilities

* **Define** the product vision, target users, success measures, and multi-quarter roadmap for platform and framework capabilities.
* **Own** backlog management end-to-end, including intake, discovery, prioritization, requirements, acceptance criteria, and release planning.
* **Prioritize** investments using quantitative and qualitative inputs such as adoption trends, user feedback, incident learnings, performance data, and support themes.
* **Drive** alignment across engineering, architecture, and senior stakeholders, facilitating trade-offs across risk, timelines, usability, and technical design.
* **Translate** ambiguous needs into clear, testable requirements and deliver iterative value through close partnership with engineering.
* **Establish** platform-level expectations for resiliency, including fault tolerance, graceful degradation, and testing practices that validate reliability under stress.
* **Define** disaster recovery readiness expectations, including recovery objectives, failover approaches, runbooks, and regular testing routines.
* **Lead** secure-by-default product outcomes by partnering on authentication and authorization approaches, secrets handling, vulnerability management, and threat modeling support.
* **Operationalize** artificial-intelligence-enabled development practices across four themes: adoption goals, prioritized use cases, workflow automation opportunities, and governance and controls (evaluation, testing, monitoring, and human review where needed).
* **Execute** enablement and adoption plans, including positioning, rollout approach, documentation, training, and feedback loops for continuous improvement.
* **Improve** developer experience through scalable onboarding, reference implementations, templates, and a support model that reduces friction and increases time-to-value.

Required qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Hands-on experience building and operating Java-based services, including application programming interfaces and distributed systems.
* 8+ years of product management experience (or equivalent expertise in a closely related domain).
* Experience defining product vision, success measures, and roadmaps and delivering against them in changing environments.
* Demonstrated backlog ownership, including discovery, prioritization, dependency management, and iterative delivery.
* Strong understanding of event-driven system design concepts (for example: messaging patterns, ordering, retries, and idempotency).
* Strong understanding of cloud and reliability concepts (for example: scaling, networking fundamentals, and multi-region resiliency patterns).
* Experience defining and driving non-functional expectations for platforms, including resiliency, disaster recovery readiness, and security outcomes.
* Experience using operational and customer signals (metrics, incidents, performance data, support themes) to make prioritization decisions and demonstrate value.
* Proven ability to influence senior technical stakeholders and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
* Strong written communication skills for product requirements, decision records, and roadmap narratives.

Preferred qualifications, capabilities and skills

* Experience building or scaling developer platforms, shared libraries, service frameworks, or reference implementations.
* Familiarity with Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, and Spring Security ecosystems.
* Familiarity with reactive versus traditional web service patterns and schema-based interface approaches such as GraphQL.
* Experience defining governance for interfaces, including versioning and deprecation practices.
* Experience leading adoption programs for internal platforms, including enablement content and success measurement.
* Familiarity with observability practices, including service-level measures, logging, metrics, tracing, and incident review processes.
* Experience supporting artificial-intelligence-enabled products or development practices, including evaluation methods, monitoring approaches, and governance considerations.

  
**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression,…

As Senior Product Manager, you will lead product strategy and delivery across the Fraud and ID Agent Initiative, from the current MVP through the roadmap toward a scalable, production-ready capability. You will connect client and analyst needs with fraud expertise, data science, engineering, platform, legal, compliance, and AI governance partners. You will own the product outcomes, priorities, and decisions that keep the program useful, safe, and deliverable.

What you will do

* **Set product direction.** Define the product vision, and measurable outcomes for fraud and identity capabilities, balancing the near-term pilot with a reusable longer-term product.
* **Lead discovery with users and partners.** Work with the Brazil pilot partner and fraud specialists to understand analyst workflows, emerging fraud patterns, data needs, and what makes a recommendation actionable and.
* **Coordinate global delivery.** Align the Brazil business and data team with India-based engineering, architecture and platform teams, and partner stakeholders. Establish clear ownership, resolve blockers, and maintain a operating cadence across teams.
* **Guide responsible use of data and AI.** Partner on data access, privacy, security, AI governance, model quality, explainability, auditability, and controls. The current design uses rules and statistical methods to detect patterns, then uses an LLM to explain findings and draft recommendations.
* **Measure product performance.** Define how the team will evaluate detection quality, time to analyst review, fraud outcomes, recommendation usefulness, analyst adoption, and operational impact. Establish validation plans before expanding beyond the pilot.
* **Build the next-phase roadmap.** Use evidence from the pilot to prioritize production readiness, broader data coverage, a purpose-built analyst experience, and future client or regional expansion.
* You will report to the Senior Director of Product Management
* You will have to WFO 2 days a week as its Hybrid working

  
**Qualifications**  

* You are required to have 8+ years of product management experience, including ownership of complex, data-intensive products from discovery through launch and iteration.
* Experience in fraud, identity, payments, financial services, risk decisioning, or a closely related domain.
* Work closely with engineering and data science on data pipelines, model or rules-based systems, integrations, experimentation, and production constraints.
* Strong product judgment: you can turn an ambiguous problem into a focused roadmap, make trade-offs explicit, and connect delivery to customer and business outcomes.
* Experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing senior stakeholders across regions, functions, and organizational boundaries.

**Preferred experience**

* Building or scaling AI/ML-enabled products, especially human-reviewed decision support or agentic workflows.
* Working with sensitive customer data, privacy or compliance reviews, model governance, and audit requirements.
* Launching products with international teams, pilot partners, or multi-client platforms.

**Senior IT Product Analyst – Vehicle Ownership, After-Sales & Service**

**Location:** GCC

**Type:** Full-Time

**Experience:** 7-9 years

**Reporting to:** Brian Yu

**Role Summary**

We are hiring a product-minded Senior IT Product Analyst to help build and scale the digital experiences that power the vehicle ownership journey. This role focuses on customer engagement, AI-powered service experiences, and ownership products across After-Sales, Ownership, Customer Care, and Service Operations.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Service, Customer Care, Legal, and Operations teams to identify customer problems, define product solutions, and deliver capabilities that improve customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and business outcomes. As part of a shared analyst pool, you will have opportunities to contribute across multiple ownership and Sales product areas as priorities evolve.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving customer problems, simplifying complex journeys, leveraging AI to create differentiated experiences, and helping shape the future of vehicle ownership through technology.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own product features end-to-end, from problem definition through launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

* Partner with Product Managers to translate customer needs, operational challenges, and business objectives into clear requirements, user stories, workflows, and acceptance criteria.

* Build and prioritize backlogs while balancing customer value, business impact, technical complexity, and delivery timelines.

* Collaborate closely with Engineering and Design to shape scalable solutions, validate assumptions, and ensure successful delivery.

* Define success metrics, monitor outcomes, and continuously improve products based on customer feedback and business performance.

**Product Builder Competencies**

  

* **Problem framing**: Starts with the customer problem and business outcome, not the solution or the system.
* **Prioritization**: Manages backlogs and makes trade-offs grounded in data and impact.
* **Customer and user feedback**: Gathers and synthesizes input from customers, frontline teams, and data to shape the product.
* **Engineering partnership**: Works side by side with engineers and designers; understands APIs, integrations, and data flows well enough to shape solutions.
* **AI fluency**: Uses AI tools hands-on in daily work (research, drafting, prototyping, analysis) and understands how AI features are designed and evaluated.
* **Ownership**: Drives work to launch and beyond, and does more than gather requirements or support users of existing systems.

**Must-Haves**

* 7+ years of experience in Product Analyst, Product Owner, Business Analyst, or related product roles building customer-facing digital products and platforms.
* Demonstrated experience delivering products and features in partnership with Engineering teams.
* Strong product mindset with experience managing backlogs, defining requirements, prioritizing work, and measuring outcomes.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools and participating in the development or implementation of AI-enabled features.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate complex business and technical concepts into clear product requirements.
* Comfortable working in Agile environments and managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

**Nice-to-Haves**

* Experience in automotive, mobility, vehicle ownership, service operations, warranty, repair management, scheduling, manufacturing, or supply chain environments.
* Understanding of the vehicle ownership lifecycle and AfterSales customer experiences.
* Salesforce experience (Service Cloud, Sales Cloud, Marketing Cloud, or related platforms).
* SAP experience
* Experience working with conversational AI, LLM-powered assistants, agent-assist solutions, or intelligent automation platforms.
* Experience with integration platforms such as Workato, MuleSoft, REST APIs, and enterprise service integrations.
* Experience mapping customer journeys, service experiences, and operational workflows.
  

**How You'll Succeed at Lucid**

* You think like a product builder and customer advocate, not just a requirements owner.
* You identify opportunities to simplify and enhance the vehicle ownership experience through technology.
* You connect customer engagement, service operations, subscriptions, and AI capabilities into cohesive product experiences.
* You use customer feedback, operational insights, and data to drive product decisions.
* You balance customer needs, business objectives, and technical feasibility to deliver meaningful outcomes.
* You leverage AI and modern product development practices to move faster, learn faster, and deliver better customer experiences.
* You are passionate about shaping the future of vehicle ownership, AfterSales, and customer engagement through innovative digital products.

jobs.description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start **Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced Product Manager to lead the strategy, development, and execution of payer content solutions and supporting reporting and analytics capabilities. This role will be responsible for driving API-based content products that help healthcare payer and provider organizations improve operational efficiency, reduce denials, lower administrative costs, and enhance customer experiences.

The ideal candidate combines solid product management expertise with deep healthcare domain knowledge, particularly within claims, benefits, prior authorization, policy management, and revenue cycle operations. This individual will work cross-functionally with engineering, operations, clinical, sales, and client-facing teams to deliver innovative, market-ready solutions that produce measurable business outcomes.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Product Strategy and Roadmap
  + Define and execute product strategy for payer content solutions and associated reporting and analytics capabilities
  + Develop and maintain product roadmaps aligned to business objectives, market opportunities, customer needs, and measurable outcomes
  + Identify opportunities to improve denial reduction, cost savings, call deflection, and operational efficiency through innovative content and analytics solutions
* Product Development and Delivery
  + Translate payer and provider business challenges into scalable API content products, reporting capabilities, and actionable product requirements
  + Partner with engineering, operations, and other stakeholders to define features, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements
  + Lead the end-to-end product lifecycle from ideation through Alpha, Beta, and General Availability (GA) releases
  + Define MVP scope, prioritize product backlogs, and ensure successful execution using Agile methodologies and product management tools
* Customer and Market Engagement
  + Collaborate with payer and provider clients to identify business needs, validate use cases, and gather product feedback
  + Ensure product capabilities align with real-world healthcare workflows, systems, and operational requirements
  + Conduct market and competitive research to identify emerging trends and opportunities within healthcare content, API-driven solutions, and analytics
* Cross-Functional Leadership
  + Drive alignment across product, engineering, operations, clinical, delivery, and go-to-market teams
  + Provide regular updates to executive leadership and key stakeholders on product performance, roadmap progress, and delivery milestones
  + Coordinate product readiness activities to support successful launches and customer adoption
* Product Enablement and Support
  + Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for payer content solutions and analytics products
  + Support the development of customer-facing and internal product documentation, training materials, and support resources
  + Partner with sales and marketing teams to strengthen product positioning, sales enablement, and go-to-market activities
* Comply with all applicable Company policies, procedures, and business directives, changes including those relating to work location, team assignments, work schedules, and flexible work arrangements

**Required Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
* 10+ years of product management experience with ownership of complex enterprise software or platform products
* Experience developing and managing healthcare technology products, preferably within payer, provider, revenue cycle, or healthcare operations environments
* Demonstrated experience with API-based products, content sourcing strategies, or platform-based solutions
* Experience defining product use cases and working closely with engineering teams to deliver scalable product capabilities
* Experience with reporting and analytics platforms, including performance measurement, KPI development, and operational reporting
* Solid understanding of Agile product development methodologies and tools such as Rally, Aha!, Jira, or similar platforms
* Proven excellent communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with healthcare content products, claims intelligence, policy content, pricing transparency, or related healthcare information services
* Experience supporting enterprise-scale healthcare platforms serving multiple customer segments
* Deep knowledge of payer and provider operations, including:
  + Claims processing
  + Benefits management
  + Prior authorization
  + Policy and editing logic
  + Revenue cycle management
  + Denial management
  + Call center operations
* Familiarity with emerging AI, automation, and agentic workflow solutions within healthcare technology

* The successful candidate will demonstrate:

* Ability to translate complex healthcare operational challenges into customer-focused product solutions
* Experience leveraging reporting and analytics data to drive product decisions, measure outcomes, and optimize performance

**Job Description: International E-commerce Sales Manager / Executive**

**Company:** Kabra Global Products Pvt. Ltd.  
**Department:** International Sales / E-commerce  
**Job Title:** International E-commerce Sales Manager / Executive  
**Experience:** 3–5 Years (preferred)  
**Location:** Hyderabad  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time

**1. Job Summary**

We are looking for a results-driven International E-commerce Sales professional to manage and expand the company's global online sales business through leading international marketplaces, including Amazon Global, Walmart Marketplace, and other relevant e-commerce platforms.

The candidate will be responsible for developing international marketplace sales, managing product listings, identifying new business opportunities, optimizing product visibility, driving revenue growth, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure smooth international order fulfillment.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in international e-commerce operations, marketplace management, digital sales strategies, and cross-border business development, preferably within the FMCG or consumer products industry.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. International Marketplace Sales**

* Manage and grow sales across international marketplaces, including Amazon US, UK, Canada, Australia, and other relevant global markets.
* Develop and execute sales strategies to increase international revenue, market share, and product visibility.
* Manage and expand business on Walmart Marketplace and other international e-commerce platforms.
* Identify new global marketplaces and online sales channels suitable for the company's product portfolio.
* Research international markets to identify growth opportunities, customer demand, and competitor strategies.
* Establish sales targets and monitor marketplace performance against revenue and profitability objectives.

**B. Marketplace Account Management**

* Manage seller accounts, product catalogs, inventory availability, pricing, promotions, and sales performance.
* Create, optimize, and maintain product listings, including titles, descriptions, images, keywords, and product attributes.

* Monitor account health, customer feedback, product reviews, returns, and marketplace performance metrics.

* Conduct keyword research and optimize product listings to improve organic search rankings.
* Analyze customer behavior, market trends, and competitor pricing to improve sales performance.
* Work towards achieving monthly and quarterly sales and profitability targets.

**D. International Business Development**

* Identify and evaluate new countries, marketplaces, distributors, and online retail partners.
* Develop strategies to expand the company's presence in international markets.
* Research market demand, pricing structures, competitor products, and customer preferences across different countries.
* Explore opportunities for direct-to-consumer sales and cross-border e-commerce.
* Build relationships with marketplace representatives, international distributors, and relevant business partners.
* Support the development of new international sales channels and commercial partnerships.
* Present marketplace performance, key challenges, and growth plans to management.

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, International Business, E-commerce, or a related field.
* 3–5 years of experience in international e-commerce sales, marketplace management, or global online business development.
* Hands-on experience managing Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central for international markets.
* Experience with Walmart Marketplace is highly preferred.
* Knowledge of other global marketplaces and e-commerce channels is an advantage.
* Understanding of international sales, cross-border e-commerce, and global marketplace operations.
* Experience in product listing optimization, pricing, promotions, and marketplace advertising.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales data and marketplace performance reports.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and marketplace analytics tools.
* Good communication, negotiation, and coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and achieve revenue and profitability targets.

**4. Preferred Experience**

* Experience in FMCG, food products, packaged consumer goods, or other consumer product categories.
* Experience selling products in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, or other international markets.
* Understanding of international marketplace fees, fulfillment models, inventory planning, and product profitability.
* Experience with Amazon FBA, FBM, or other relevant international fulfillment models.
* Familiarity with international product compliance, labeling requirements, and export documentation.
* Experience in launching new products on international marketplaces and scaling them into profitable businesses.

jobs.description:
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We’ve learned that scammers are impersonating Commvault team members—including HR and leadership—via email or text. These bad actors may conduct fake interviews and ask for personal information, such as your social security number.

**What to know:**

* Commvault does *not* conduct interviews by email or text.
* We will never ask you to submit sensitive documents (including banking information, SSN, etc) before your first day.
* Commvault recruiters may contact prospective candidates through LinkedIn and other professional networking platforms regarding career opportunities. If you are unsure whether a recruiting communication is legitimate, review the profile to ensure they have a badge verifying them as a Commvault employee.

If you suspect a recruiting scam, please contact us at wwrecruitingteam@commvault.com

  

**About Commvault**

Commvault (NASDAQ: CVLT) delivers continuous recovery for the AI era. We help organizations stay ready for constant disruption by returning critical data, applications, identities, and AI systems to a clean, trusted state. Our purpose-built recovery solutions span cloud-native and hybrid environments, leveraging AI to enable resilience at enterprise scale.

We're looking for a Principal Product Manager to own the strategy and execution for our recovery orchestration platform — the layer that automates, sequences, and validates how enterprises bring critical systems back online after an outage, ransomware event, or disaster. This is a build-and-scale mandate: you'll be responsible for unifying what are today somewhat separate capabilities into a single, coherent platform story — with the pricing, packaging, and GTM discipline to make it a durable, high-margin product line, not just a feature bundle. You'll operate at the intersection of enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, and cloud architecture, working with engineering, pricing/finance, field enablement, and customer success to take this from current state to a major platform launch.

**Key Responsibilities**

Product Strategy & Platform Vision

* Define and evolve the strategy for a unified recovery orchestration platform spanning multiple cloud workloads (compute, storage, databases) across AWS, Azure, and GCP

* Build the narrative for *why* orchestrated, tested recovery is a distinct platform capability — not a checkbox feature — for CISOs, infrastructure/DR leaders, and compliance stakeholders

* Own the roadmap sequencing across phased capability delivery

Pricing & Packaging

* Partner with Finance/Pricing to fix structural pricing issues (cost allocation across platform vs. product SKUs, bundle economics, SaaS vs. software parity) that directly affect adoption and retention

* Build the business case and options analysis for executive/CPO-level pricing decisions, using cost-vs-price framing

* Ensure packaging reflects real customer buying patterns rather than internal architecture boundaries

Cross-Functional Execution

* Drive a large, multi-team engineering workback (dozens of workstreams across workload teams, UI/UX, and platform) toward a release date

* Identify and escalate real schedule risk early and keep the leadership informed.

* Partner with field enablement and customer success to close the gap between product capability and what's actually sold, deployed, and renewed

Customer & Market Insight

* Validate positioning and pricing directly with field teams (solutions engineers, field CTOs) and customers — not just internal stakeholders

* Understand the two adjacent buyer personas this platform serves (security/CISO buyers focused on isolated recovery and forensics, and infrastructure/DR buyers focused on operational recovery) and make deliberate calls on how the platform positions to each without diluting either

* Identify new opportunities and problems to solve in the recovery space.

Executive Communication

* Write clear PRFAQs, business cases, and stakeholder updates for senior leadership audiences

* Present pricing and platform strategy directly to all stakeholders

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science or related discipline.
* 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in enterprise infrastructure, cybersecurity, cloud platforms, or data resilience (backup/DR/ransomware recovery adjacent domains)

* Demonstrated experience owning pricing and packaging decisions with measurable business impact (not just feature roadmaps)

* Experience running large, cross-team technical programs with a hard external deadline (multiple engineering teams, dozens of dependencies, workback tracking)

* Strong grasp of cloud infrastructure fundamentals across at least one hyperscaler (AWS, Azure, or GCP) — compute, storage, database recovery patterns

* Track record of building platform narratives for technical, security-conscious enterprise buyers (CISO, VP Infrastructure, Head of DR)

Excellent written communication — comfortable producing PRDs, PRFAQs, and exec-level business cases independently  



**Preferred Skills & Experience**

* Master's Degree preferred.
* Direct experience with backup, disaster recovery, cyber recovery, or ransomware resilience products

* Familiarity with isolated recovery environment concepts (malware scanning, forensics-safe validation environments)

* Experience managing SKU/pricing structures across SaaS and on-prem/software delivery models

* Background partnering with channel/field enablement teams on complex technical products

Milestone culture is built to provide a collaborative, inclusive environment that supports employees and empowers them to reach their full potential.
  
  
Our seasoned professionals deliver services based on Milestone’s best practices and service delivery framework. By leveraging our vast knowledge base to execute initiatives, we deliver both short-term and long-term value to our clients and apply continuous service improvement to deliver transformational benefits to IT. With Intelligent Automation, Milestone helps businesses further accelerate their IT transformation. The result is a sharper focus on business objectives and a dramatic improvement in employee productivity. Through our key technology partnerships and our people-first approach, Milestone continues to deliver industry-leading innovation to our clients. With more than 3,000 employees serving over 200 companies worldwide, we are following our mission of revolutionizing the way IT is deployed.
  
  
**Job Overview**
Senior Product Manager, Data Platform
  
  
**About The Role**
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead our consumer data platform. We have a modern cloud lakehouse in place and are now building the consumer data foundation on top of it: a canonical data model, a consumer data warehouse, and one trusted source of data for analytics, data science, risk and finance teams.
  
  
You’ll own the roadmap from the start. You’ll decide which use cases to deliver first, define how core consumer entities are modeled, and make sure each new use case builds on shared data instead of one-off pipelines. You’ll work closely with data engineering, data architecture, analytics and risk teams.
  
  
*This is not a dashboard-building role. You’ll own the data, definitions and metrics that dashboards, models and reports are built on.*
What you’ll do in your first 12 months
  
  

* Build a prioritized backlog of consumer data use cases with analytics, data science, risk and finance, and decide which 3–5 to deliver first.
* Define canonical consumer entities, such as customer, account, transaction, fee, merchant, country and currency, so they mean the same thing across products.
* Decide where products share a common model and where they need their own structures, and document the reasoning.
* Define single, governed definitions for core consumer KPIs such as active customers, revenue per user, lifetime value and churn.
* Write requirements engineers can build from: source-to-target mappings, grain, keys, history rules and data-quality checks.
* Track adoption: which teams have moved to the new models, how much they’re being used, and how many metric discrepancies have been resolved.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or an MBA, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years in a data product or risk data role.
* Experience starting with many competing data requests, choosing the few to build first, defining an MVP, and explaining the trade-offs to stakeholders.
* Experience working with engineering to deliver a data lake/lakehouse, data warehouse or shared data model used by multiple teams.
* Experience bringing together inconsistent data from multiple source systems into common entities, keys and definitions.
* Hands-on SQL: you can join across tables, profile data for nulls and duplicates, reconcile counts between systems, and check whether data supports a use case without waiting for an analyst.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consumer payments, digital wallets or fintech.
* Experience with payments risk data such as fraud, account takeover, KYC/AML or transaction monitoring signals.
* Experience with modern cloud data platforms and tools, such as Snowflake, Databricks, dbt or major cloud providers’ data services.

jobs.title: VMS Product Manager / VMS Product Owner
jobs.description:
**Description:** This role aligns with industry titles such as Vendor Management Systems (VMS) Program Manager, MSP Program Manager, VMS product Manager or Beeline VMS Administrator

  

**The Role**

We are the HR Product Owner team. We decide what gets built in Oracle and ServiceNow, in what order, and why. The HR community brings us their problems and their ideas, and we make sure they get into the system, get prioritised, and get tested before they reach anyone. Our colleagues never need to go to the technology teams directly. That is our job.

Each of us owns a domain end to end: onboarding and offboarding journeys, leave and absence, talent management, benefits and vendor management. This role adds the one domain we are missing.

As Program Manager and PO for Contingent Workforce, you will own the contingent worker journey as a product, from the moment someone is sourced, through onboarding, extensions and role changes, to the day they leave and their access is closed cleanly. Hire to retire, with one owner.

Today that journey runs across a vendor management system, Oracle Fusion, ServiceNow and our identity platforms, with different teams owning different pieces and nobody holding the whole thread. A working prototype already exists: a single conversational front door where a hiring manager gives the information once and the systems do the rest, with no tickets raised at all. Your job is to take that from a promising prototype to a permanent service, and to extend it across the full lifecycle.

This is not a role about keeping a system running. You will bring a process architect mindset to simplify genuine complexity, working with shared services, global HR systems and emerging technologies such as robotic process automation and artificial intelligence, so that the contingent worker experience becomes something we design rather than something that happens.

  

**What You'll Own**

* Own the contingent worker journey end to end as a product, with a clear roadmap, prioritised increments and measurable outcomes.
* Act as business owner of our vendor management system (Beeline), covering configuration, supplier onboarding, rate card structures, worker classification and reporting.
* Manage the relationship with the vendor management system provider and with staffing suppliers, holding both to agreed service levels.
* Map the journey across Talent Acquisition, Procurement, Finance, IT, Security, and the country teams, then redesign it rather than simply document it.
* Identify where policy rather than technology is the real blocker, and build the case to change it.
* Maintain the role-based profile model so that access and equipment are provisioned automatically for standard roles, and manually only for genuine exceptions.
* Translate what you learn into what gets built in Oracle and ServiceNow, and see it through to testing and adoption.
* Work alongside the Global Process Owner for Hire-to-Onboard, and with the teams building provisioning for permanent employees, so we converge on one pattern rather than several.
* Bring security, compliance and audit in early, not at the point of go-live.
* Define and track what good looks like: time from source to day one, day one readiness, tickets raised per worker, and satisfaction of both the worker and the hiring manager.

  

**About You**

* Five to eight years of experience in contingent workforce programmes, managed service provider models, or HR operations with direct contingent workforce responsibility.
* Hands-on ownership of a vendor management system such as Beeline or SAP Fieldglass, including configuration, supplier management and reporting. Experience as an end user alone is not enough for this role.
* A process architect mindset: you can map a cross-functional journey, find where the time and the friction actually sit, and simplify it.
* Comfort with data. You build the measurement case yourself rather than waiting for a report.
* Proven success working in a matrix environment, influencing across functions without direct authority.
* Curiosity and openness to innovation, including robotic process automation, artificial intelligence and agent-based workflows.
* Clear written communication. Much of this role is making a complex journey understandable to people who own only one part of it.
* Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion, ServiceNow and identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra is an advantage.
* Understanding of contingent worker classification and compliance requirements across multiple countries is an advantage.

  

**What You'll Get**

You will own a journey that thousands of people at Pearson experience, and you will own it properly: the system, the process, the suppliers and the roadmap. Few roles at this level give you that much of a canvas.

You will also arrive at the right moment. The problem is already evidenced, a prototype already works, and there is executive attention on the outcome. What is missing is a single owner to turn it into something permanent and scale it.

As the world's leading learning company, Pearson is transforming how people learn, work and grow. You will be based in India and working globally, with hybrid and flexible working, and with a team of product owners around you who are solving the same kind of problem in their own domains.

**Ready to make an Impact?**

Apply now and help shape whats next.

The group delivers reusable platforms, automation, standards, and engineering mentorship across AWS API Gateway, Apigee, the API Management Hub, and developer enablement experiences. As a Sr. Consultant - Infrastructure Engineering at Principal, you will be a senior hands-on engineer entrusted with independently managing complex API platform capabilities from creation through production support. This role integrates software engineering, cloud platform engineering, API lifecycle management, automation, operational reliability, and technical mentoring across distributed teams. This is a remarkable opportunity to work on innovative technology and contribute to a world-class team!

* Coordinate the build, engineering, development, and production support of the API platform and self-service capabilities, including the API Management Hub and developer portals.

* Practical experience working directly with AWS CDK and API or event-driven services, such as API Gateway, Lambda, IAM, CloudWatch, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, and Route 53.

And we support our employees the same way we support our customers: with comprehensive, competitive benefit offerings crafted to protect their physical, financial, and social well-being. Check out our careers site to learn more about our purpose, values and benefits.

jobs.title: Product Owner
jobs.description:
The Product Owner (PO) within Kroll’s Chief Data Office (CDO) is accountable for the end‑to‑end ownership, delivery, and adoption of enterprise data products. This role serves as the single point of accountability for product vision, stakeholder alignment, roadmap execution, and experience quality across assigned data domains.
  
  
The Product Owner partners closely with
**Business stakeholders, Data Engineering, BI/Reporting, Data Science, Governance, and Platform teams**
to ensure data products are reliable, intuitive, scalable, and aligned with Kroll’s strategic priorities. The role emphasizes
**clarity of ownership, predictable delivery, and measurable business impact**
in a complex, enterprise data environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product Ownership & Accountability**

* Define and own the product vision, roadmap, and backlog for enterprise data, analytics, or AI product areas.
* Serve as the single point of accountability for product outcomes, delivery health, and user experience.
* Define and communicate product goals, success metrics, and value drivers to stakeholders and delivery teams.
* Ensure products operate with clear ownership, release discipline, and lifecycle management, behaving like true products—not one‑off projects.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Business Alignment**

* Act as the primary interface between the CDO and business, finance, and functional leaders for assigned domains.
* Partner with stakeholders to prioritize demand, manage tradeoffs, and align delivery to business timelines.
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements without compromising data integrity or architectural standards.
* Establish and maintain trusted relationships that enable fast decision‑making and alignment.

**Backlog, Roadmap & Delivery Management**

* Own and maintain a prioritized, well‑defined backlog with clear acceptance criteria and readiness standards.
* Work with Program Managers, Scrum Masters, and delivery teams to plan releases and manage dependencies.
* Balance short‑term delivery needs with long‑term product health, scalability, and maintainability.
* Surface risks, constraints, or scope trade‑offs early to enable leadership decisions.

**Governance, Quality & Standards**

* Partner with Data Governance, Data Stewards, and Platform Owners to ensure:

+ Consistent KPI definitions and metric logic
+ Data quality, lineage, and trust standards
+ Alignment with enterprise data architecture and security policies

* Ensure products meet operational readiness standards prior to release and are supported post‑launch.

**Adoption, Value & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive product adoption by ensuring solutions is intuitive, reliable, and aligned to real user workflows.
* Define and track usage, adoption, and value realization metrics.
* Collect feedback and iterate to continuously improve product experience and impact.
* Support leadership by providing a clear narrative on what is delivered, what value it creates, and what comes next.

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Data‑centric roles.
* Proven ability to own roadmaps, backlogs, and stakeholder relationships in a complex enterprise environment.
* Strong understanding of data, reporting, analytics, or BI platforms (e.g., Power BI, Databricks, data warehouses).
* Experience working in Agile or hybrid delivery models with engineering and analytics teams.
* Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to translate between business objectives and technical execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience in a Chief Data Office, Analytics, or Enterprise Reporting organization.
* Familiarity with data governance, semantic models, KPI standardization, and self‑service analytics.
* Experience supporting finance, operations, or enterprise‑wide reporting domains.
* Prior experience working in a vendor‑heavy environment and helping transition to more internal ownership.

**Leadership Behaviors & Expectations**

* Operates with clear ownership and accountability.
* Brings structure, clarity, and discipline to ambiguous problem spaces.
* Makes trade‑offs explicitly and escalates decisions appropriately.
* Focuses on outcomes and value, not just delivery.

jobs.description:
***Ready to shape how Technology costs are planned and recharged?***

**Why HSBC**

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

**The Opportunity**

This role sits at the centre of how HSBC plans, forecasts and recharges Technology and Infrastructure costs to internal customers. You’ll support and administer Time Capture and GPDM (Group Planning Data Model) planning and forecasting applications ensuring data integrity, user support and clear process governance. Working closely with Finance, Technology, Commercial Operations, Controllers and business stakeholders you’ll help keep planning, forecasting, recharge and billing activities aligned. Success means accurate allocation methodologies, clear month-end reporting and timely investigation of variances so recoveries and billing outcomes improve. You’ll also strengthen financial controls and documentation to meet governance, regulatory and audit expectations. Alongside the day-to-day cadence you’ll help progress automation, system enhancements and new allocation and billing capabilities across HIBS, GPDM and related platforms.

**What you'll be doing**

* Support and administer Time Capture and GPDM forecasting and planning applications ensuring data integrity and user support
* Oversee process governance across planning, forecasting, recharge and billing activities to keep them aligned
* Produce monthly reporting, management information and variance analysis on charges, recoveries, allocations and financial performance
* Investigate over- and under-recoveries including root-cause analysis and remediation actions to improve billing accuracy
* Manage allocation drivers, reference data, FTE billing inputs, cost models and recharge methodologies in line with governance requirements
* Partner with Finance, Technology, Commercial Operations, Controllers and business stakeholders to resolve billing exceptions and disputes
* Maintain financial controls, reconciliations, audit trails and supporting documentation to meet audit and regulatory expectations
* Deliver process improvements, automation initiatives, testing and system enhancements across HIBS, GPDM and related platforms

**What we're looking for**

* Bring qualified accountant, part-qualified accountant or equivalent relevant finance experience
* Demonstrate experience in financial analysis, management reporting, cost allocation, recharges or chargebacks in a complex organisation
* Apply a strong understanding of financial controls, reconciliations, accounting concepts and audit requirements
* Work confidently with cost and volume data across multiple countries, currencies, legal entities or internal customers
* Perform variance investigation and root-cause analysis and escalate material issues appropriately
* Use Excel effectively and work confidently with large data sets
* Prepare clear, accurate financial reporting for finance and non-finance stakeholders
* Partner effectively across Technology and Finance to resolve allocation queries and maintain delivery cadence

**Strengthening cost transparency**

If you want to help improve how Technology and Infrastructure costs are planned, governed and recovered this role offers real scope to make a difference. You’ll work on processes and platforms that underpin recharge outcomes for internal customers and support better financial decision-making. The focus is on accuracy, control and continuous improvement across recurring cycles and change initiatives. If that matches the work you want to do we’d welcome your application.

**You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.**

jobs.description:
**Business Development & Market Intelligence Executive**
========================================================

**Role Purpose**
----------------

To generate qualified market intelligence and business opportunities by identifying new projects, architects, consultants, PMCs, decision-makers, competitors, market movements, and potential customers. This role supports sales by creating a strong pipeline of researched, qualified, and prioritised leads.

This is not a desk-only marketing job. It requires research, calling, networking, database building, project tracking, and sometimes field visits.

**Ideal Candidate**
-------------------

* **Experience:** 58 years
* **Qualification:** Graduate / MBA preferred but not compulsory
* **Background:** Business development, project sales, B2B sales, construction/building materials, industrial products, institutional sales, or channel development
* **Skills:** Research, calling, market mapping, relationship-building, LinkedIn use, database discipline, competitor tracking, and opportunity qualification

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **A. Market Research & Lead Intelligence**

* Build and maintain a database of upcoming and new projects.
* Identify architects, consultants, PMCs, contractors, builders, developers, institutional buyers, and key decision-makers.
* Gather project details such as project stage, location, size, consultant involved, purchase timeline, decision-makers, and possible requirements.
* Track tenders, industry portals, exhibitions, trade associations, LinkedIn, project reports, and market sources.
* Create a qualified pipeline instead of random data dumping.

### **B. Competitor Intelligence**

* Track competitor activity in target markets.
* Collect information on competitor pricing, product positioning, client base, project wins, dealer network, delivery timelines, and service complaints.
* Share monthly competitor intelligence reports with management.
* Identify where competitors are weak and where Macan/Goodluck can position better.

### **C. Lead Qualification**

* Call and verify leads before passing them to the sales team.
* Identify whether the lead has real potential, budget, timeline, authority, and requirements.
* Categorise leads as hot, warm, cold, future, or irrelevant.
* Share only qualified leads with the sales team along with proper background notes.

### **D. Sales Support**

* Support sales representatives with background research before meetings.
* Prepare customer/project briefs before sales visits.
* Help identify the right person to contact in each organisation.
* Track sales progress on leads generated by this role.
* Help revive dormant customers or old enquiries with new intelligence.

### **E. Database Management**

* Maintain a clean database of architects, consultants, PMCs, project owners, builders, customers, and decision-makers.
* Update phone numbers, email IDs, LinkedIn profiles, project status, and relationship notes.
* Remove duplicate, outdated, and irrelevant entries.
* Share weekly lead reports with management and the sales team.

-----------------------------------------------------------------

**KRA**

**Measurement**

New project database

Number of relevant projects identified

  

Lead quality

% leads accepted by sales as useful

  

Decision-maker mapping

% leads with the correct contact person identified

  

Competitor intelligence

Monthly actionable competitor report

  

Sales pipeline contribution

Number/value of opportunities created

  

Market coverage

Architects, consultants, PMCs, and regions mapped

  

Lead qualification

Hot/warm/cold categorisation accuracy

**KPIs**
--------

* Number of new projects identified per month

* Number of architects/consultants/PMCs added to database

* Number of decision-makers verified

* Number of qualified leads passed to sales

* Percentage of leads accepted by the sales team

* Number of leads converted into meetings

* Number of leads converted into quotations

* Number of competitor insights submitted

* Number of old leads revived

* Monthly pipeline value generated

jobs.description:
**Job Description: Business Analyst**
– Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Role: Business Analyst – Data In-Licensing & Data Governance Domain: Life Sciences / Pharmaceutical R&D Engagement Focus: Current-State Assessment, Gap Analysis, Requirements Definition & Future State Roadmap Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Business Analyst with strong knowledge of data governance, data licensing, data lifecycle management, and enterprise data management practices to support an assessment of the Data In-Licensing process within Novartis Biomedical Research (NIBR). The individual will work closely with business, scientific research, data management, legal, procurement, compliance, and technology stakeholders to assess the current operating model, identify process and technology gaps, and recommend improvements to strengthen governance, compliance, traceability, and operational efficiency across the licensed data lifecycle. Key
**Responsibilities**

1. Data In-Licensing Process Assessment Analyze the end-to-end data in-licensing lifecycle, from data acquisition and contractual agreements through onboarding, provisioning, consumption, renewal, expiry, and retirement. Conduct stakeholder interviews and workshops to understand the current operating model, systems, responsibilities, and pain points. Identify manual activities, fragmented workflows, unclear ownership, and opportunities for automation. Prepare AS-IS process maps, gap assessments, and recommended TO-BE workflows.

2. Data Bill of Materials (DBoM) and License Management Define business requirements for a centralized Data Bill of Materials to track all licensed datasets. Identify essential metadata, including data provider, dataset ownership, licensing terms, permitted usage, restrictions, contractual obligations, renewal dates, expiration timelines, and retention requirements. Assess current mechanisms for tracking licensed datasets and their downstream dependencies. Define requirements for notifications, license renewals, compliance checkpoints, and expiry management.

3. Access Governance and Entitlement Management Assess existing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) and entitlement management processes. Map user roles, access privileges, approval workflows, and data usage restrictions to contractual requirements. Identify gaps in access approvals, access reviews, and entitlement revocation. Define business requirements for visibility into who accesses licensed datasets, for what purpose, and under which permissions.

4. Data Lifecycle and Retention Management Evaluate existing practices for data retention, archival, expiration, and secure deletion. Translate contractual retention and deletion obligations into actionable business requirements. Identify gaps in handling expired licenses, downstream copies, and derived datasets. Define requirements for deletion workflows, approvals, exception handling, and evidence of deletion.

5. Auditability, Data Lineage, and Compliance Assess the organization's ability to trace licensed data from acquisition to consumption. Define requirements for audit trails, usage monitoring, and end-to-end data lineage. Identify gaps in demonstrating compliance with contractual usage restrictions and internal governance policies. Work with risk, legal, and compliance stakeholders to define reporting and audit evidence requirements.

6. Gap Analysis and Future-State Recommendations Consolidate findings into a structured gap assessment covering people, process, technology, and governance. Prioritize gaps based on business impact, contractual exposure, operational risk, and implementation complexity. Develop business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and a prioritized improvement backlog. Collaborate with the Data Engineer and solution architects to define feasible remediation options and a phased implementation roadmap.

**Required Skills and Experience**

• 6–10 years of Business Analysis experience, preferably in pharmaceutical, life sciences, research data, or regulated enterprise environments.

• Experience with data governance, data management, data cataloging, and metadata management.

• Understanding of data licensing, contractual data usage restrictions, and third-party data management.

• Strong knowledge of RBAC, access governance, data lifecycle management, and audit requirements.

• Experience with business process mapping, stakeholder workshops, gap assessments, and requirements documentation.

• Familiarity with SQL, relational databases, data lineage concepts, and enterprise data architectures.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Skills**

• Exposure to pharmaceutical R&D or scientific research data ecosystems.

• Experience with data governance/catalog platforms such as Collibra, Informatica, Alation, or equivalent.

• Understanding of GDPR, retention policies, contractual compliance, and internal data governance standards.

• Experience working with Jira, Confluence, Visio, or BPMN modeling tools.

**Expected Deliverables**

• Current-State Data In-Licensing Process Assessment.

• Stakeholder and System Interaction Mapping.

• End-to-End Process and Governance Gap Analysis.

• DBoM Business Requirements and Metadata Definition.

• Access Control, Entitlement, Retention, and Deletion Requirements.

• Auditability and Data Traceability Requirements.

• Future-State Process Recommendations.

• Prioritized Business Requirements and Remediation Roadmap. Primary Outcome: A comprehensive understanding of business and governance gaps, with actionable recommendations to establish an efficient, compliant, and traceable data in-licensing process.

software.

Maven or Gradle, and JUnit.

Job Description: Manager, Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)

  

Company: Standard Engineering Technology Limited

Department: Finance Reporting to: Group Chief Financial Officer Qualification: CA / CMA / MBA in Finance Experience: **6-12 years** of relevant experience, preferably in manufacturing, engineering or project-based businesses.

  

Role Overview

The FP&A Manager will drive budgeting, forecasting, financial analysis and management reporting across the Company and its subsidiaries. The role will work closely with business heads to improve profitability, manage working capital and support investment decisions through timely financial insights.

Key Responsibilities

1. Budgeting and Forecasting

* Lead the annual budgeting process and prepare consolidated budgets across group companies.
* Develop rolling forecasts for revenue, expenditure, profitability, cash flows and capital expenditure.
* Review business assumptions with functional heads and evaluate alternative operating scenarios.

2. Management Reporting and Business Analysis

* Prepare monthly MIS and management dashboards covering financial and operational performance.
* Analyse actual performance against budgets, forecasts and prior periods, explaining key variances and corrective actions.
* Track order intake, order book execution, revenue visibility, margins and business performance across subsidiaries.
* Prepare financial presentations for management and Board reviews.

3. Costing and Profitability

* Analyse profitability by product, customer, project and business unit.
* Review material costs, labour costs, manufacturing overheads and capacity utilisation.

4. Working Capital and Cash Flow

* Monitor receivables, inventory, work in progress, payables and the cash conversion cycle.
* Prepare cash flow forecasts and identify funding requirements.
* Track overdue collections, customer advances, retention amounts and project billing milestones.
* Coordinate with sales, procurement and operations teams to improve working capital efficiency.

5. Capital Expenditure and Strategic Support

* Evaluate capital expenditure proposals, capacity expansion and new business opportunities.
* Prepare financial models covering return on investment, payback period and sensitivity analysis.
* Monitor approved project expenditure and review performance against investment assumptions.
* Support acquisition evaluations and post-acquisition performance monitoring.

6. Systems and Business Partnership

* Standardise reporting formats, financial definitions and planning processes across group companies.
* Improve reporting automation through ERP systems, Excel and Power BI.
* Work with accounting teams to ensure accuracy and consistency of management reporting.
* Partner with business heads to translate financial analysis into measurable action plans.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong financial modelling, budgeting, forecasting and analytical skills.
* Sound understanding of manufacturing costs, project profitability and working capital.
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with Power BI and SAP Business One is preferred.
* Ability to consolidate and interpret financial information across multiple entities.
* Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain financial results clearly.
* Attention to detail, ownership and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.

Key Performance Indicators

* Timeliness and accuracy of budgets, forecasts and monthly MIS.
* Quality of variance analysis and closure of agreed corrective actions.
* Measurable contribution to margin improvement and cost savings.
* Improvement in working capital visibility and cash flow forecasting.
* Timely evaluation and monitoring of capital expenditure.
* Progress in reporting automation and standardisation across the Group.Role & responsibilities

Overview  
  
  

**Are you ready for what’s next, now?**
  
  
**About the Role**

The **Staff** **Product Manager – Data & Analytics** supports the definition and evolution of Aptean's semantic data models and Analytics Packages across business domains and products. The role translates business processes, metrics, reporting requirements, and underlying product data into reusable semantic definitions that can support analytics and AI use cases. Working closely with domain SMEs, customers, Product, Data Engineering, and Architecture, this role drives requirements from discovery through definition, technical validation, and customer validation. The role requires a strong combination of product thinking, business analysis, analytics, and hands-on understanding of relational data and data modeling.

jobs.description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

**Product Manager**, **Shipping as a Service** (L24)

  
  

**About the Team and the Role**

  
  

**eBay Shipping is evolving from a marketplace capability into a reusable global platform.** Our ambition is to make eBay's shipping services available to eBay entities and subsidiaries, external marketplaces, third-party commerce and logistics platforms, and sellers operating across multiple channels.

We are looking for a customer-obsessed Senior Product Manager to own the end-to-end partner and client journey - from opportunity discovery and solution shaping through integration, launch and adoption. You will help early clients succeed while ensuring their needs are translated into scalable platform patterns rather than one-off implementations.

This role sits at the intersection of B2B product, developer experience and global go-to-market. You will work closely with eBay Shipping Product and Engineering teams, Design, Analytics, Business, Legal, Finance, Operations and partner-management teams to create a repeatable model for bringing new clients onto the platform.

  
  

**What you will Accomplish**

* Define the product strategy and roadmap for client onboarding, partner integrations and adoption of Shipping as a Service.

* Segment and prioritize target customers and use cases across eBay entities, subsidiaries, marketplaces, third-party platforms, high-volume sellers and multi-channel businesses.

* Own the complete client journey from discovery and requirements through technical integration, certification, production launch, growth and support.

* Develop repeatable integration patterns, reference journeys and onboarding playbooks that reduce time to first API call, first label and production scale.

* Partner with the Platform PM and Engineering teams to translate client needs into reusable APIs, configuration and operational capabilities.

* Shape the developer and partner experience, including documentation, onboarding, authentication and access controls, sandbox journeys, sample applications, integration checklists, and support processes.

* Work with client teams to define embedded shipping experiences that are simple, trustworthy and consistent while allowing appropriate flexibility for their customers.

* Lead cross-functional launch readiness across Product, Engineering, Business, Legal, Security, Payments, Reconciliation, Shipping Operations, Customer Support and Analytics.

* Build feedback loops with clients and partners to identify friction, prioritize improvements and continuously strengthen the platform proposition.

* Establish and own adoption metrics such as integration cycle time, activation, active clients, shipment volume, repeat usage, support contacts and partner satisfaction.

* Tell a compelling product and business story that aligns senior stakeholders around target clients, investment priorities, launch sequencing and measurable outcomes.

  
  

**What you will Bring**

* 3+ years of product management experience, ideally across B2B, B2B2C, marketplaces, SaaS, developer products or platform integrations.

* Experience taking complex integrations from early discovery through production launch and adoption.

* Strong customer-discovery skills and the ability to distinguish reusable platform needs from client-specific requests.

* A track record of designing effective onboarding, activation or partner experiences using qualitative insight and funnel data.

* Strong understanding of APIs and technical integrations, with the ability to work credibly with client and platform engineering teams.

* Excellent product judgement, prioritization and execution discipline in ambiguous, multi-stakeholder environments.

* Strong analytical mindset; comfortable defining metrics, measuring integration and adoption funnels, and using data to prioritize improvements.

* Exceptional communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to align senior internal leaders and external partners.

* Ability to operate globally across markets, time zones, regulatory models and different client operating contexts.

**Additional Details**

eBay is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, and disability, or other legally protected status. If you have a need that requires accommodation, please contact us at talent@ebay.com. We will make every effort to respond to your request for accommodation as soon as possible. Become a Part of the NIKE, Inc. Team

NIKE, Inc. does more than outfit the world’s best athletes. It is a place to explore potential, obliterate boundaries and push out the edges of what can be. The company looks for people who can grow, think, dream and create. Its culture thrives by embracing diversity and rewarding imagination. The brand seeks achievers, leaders and visionaries. At NIKE, Inc. it’s about each person bringing skills and passion to a challenging and constantly evolving game.

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**

This role reports to the Manager, Software Engineering, within Global Procurement Technology at the India Technology Center (ITC) in Bangalore.

The ITC team supports global procurement and corporate functions, enabling NIKE to operate efficiently and at scale across regions. As the lead technical program manager for indirect procurement, you will own the end-to-end program strategy for Source-to-Pay (S2P) solutions and coach TPMs who execute roadmaps for individual product areas.

Successful delivery and operational excellence in this role depend on close collaboration with:

* Senior TPMs, software engineers, architects, analysts, and business partners across indirect procurement products such as Coupa, Tririga, Beeline, Concur, Aravo, and related SaaS platforms
* Core ERP teams (SAP S/4HANA, ECC, and Oracle) covering accounts payable, tax, and related domains
* Engineering, security, and enterprise architecture partners
* External SaaS vendors and technology partners
  

  
  

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

We are seeking a seasoned technical program leader with deep expertise in procurement processes and platforms, particularly integrating sourcing and procurement SaaS with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA). The successful candidate combines hands-on S2P and P2P knowledge with proven ability to define multi-horizon roadmaps, lead TPMs, and influence senior business and technology stakeholders in a global enterprise.

  

In this role, you will own product vision and roadmap articulation, portfolio prioritization, program governance, and delivery cadence across scrum teams. You will facilitate workshops and design discussions at the portfolio level, validate requirements and solution approaches, mentor senior and junior TPMs, and partner with procurement leadership to deliver scalable, audit-ready capabilities worldwide.

  

This position is based in Bangalore, India. We welcome applications from candidates currently residing in Bangalore as well as those willing to relocate.
  
**Required Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8+ years in software engineering, technical program management, or product delivery with a strong focus on procurement processes and platforms, including hands-on experience integrating multiple indirect procurement tools with SAP (ECC and S/4HANA).
* Demonstrated leadership of TPMs or cross-functional delivery teams across P2P and S2P products, SaaS-based procurement systems, and ERP master and transactional data flows.
* Expertise in integration strategy—source-to-target mapping, payload design, transformations, and patterns spanning APIs, events, batch/file, and middleware—with ability to guide architects and engineers.
* Proficiency with portfolio and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, and Lucid (or equivalents); experience defining prioritization frameworks and operating rhythms for global programs.
* Exceptional communication and executive presence, with the ability to synthesize complex technical and process topics for business, engineering, and vendor audiences.
* Comfort leading in a fast-paced, results-oriented, global environment with competing priorities and ambiguous problem spaces.
* Strong collaboration skills and a growth mindset: you develop others, model curiosity, and drive continuous improvement across teams and vendors.
  

**WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON**

* You will define and communicate the vision and roadmap for enterprise Source-to-Pay and procurement technology that supports Nike's global indirect procurement operations.
* You will lead portfolio-level prioritization with procurement, finance, and technology leaders—balancing demand, risk, cost, and capability—and drive decisions to clear commitments.
* You will translate strategic intent into phased delivery plans, success metrics, and well-scoped backlogs, guiding teams on out-of-the-box SaaS use versus justified extensions.
* You will mentor and develop TPMs and senior engineers on delivery execution, stakeholder engagement, and program governance.
* You will partner with ERP, security, enterprise architecture, and external SaaS vendors to align solutions with Nike standards, integration patterns, and long-term platform direction.
* You will establish program health metrics, release readiness criteria, and escalation paths so teams deliver predictably across regions.
* You will anticipate regulatory, audit, and operational needs (e.g., SOX, data residency, vendor SLAs) and embed them in roadmap planning.

NIKE, Inc. is a growth company that looks for team members to grow with it. Nike offers a generous total rewards package, casual work environment, a diverse and inclusive culture, and an electric atmosphere for professional development. No matter the location, or the role, every Nike employee shares one galvanizing mission: To bring inspiration and innovation to every athlete\* in the world.

NIKE, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or disability.
