jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

About Amazon.com
  
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
About the Role
  
Team Manager, Vendor Consultants Team - RBS AVS  
As a Vendor Consultants Manager in Retail Business Services (RBS), you will have the exciting opportunity to help shape and deliver on the strategy for managing Amazon vendors.
  
RBS team is looking for a customer centric, driven, and creative people leader to join our team. The role leads a team of Vendor Consultants responsible for managing business growth for some of the most influential Selling Partners (vendors) on Amazon, ensuring Selling Partner satisfaction with the program through a high level of service and operational standards. In this role, you will manage strategic joint business plans for Selling Partners across your team by collaborating with them to explore innovative ways to identify and execute new operational improvement opportunities. You will interface internally with leaders from our Retail and Vendor Services teams and will be responsible for all operational aspects of the vendor’s business with Amazon. Your team will engage directly with multiple internal teams to optimize the product line for key manufacturers (vendors) on Amazon. The candidate thrives in an ambiguous environment where they must develop, implement and iterate data, processes, mechanisms and guardrails to improve the customer experience. Further, the candidate is a business owner who understands the key levers to drive business growth and can operationalize those levers across their team. They have a passion for people leadership and are at their best when they’re building, developing and managing high-performing teams. Your team will utilize a wide range of skills and work across major functional areas such as site merchandising, buying, inventory management, finance, operations and online marketing, to drive the performance of strategic vendor partners at Amazon. In this role you will be focused on the strategic and operational aspects of managing the customer relationships.  
You will lead the team that looks into strategic and operational aspects of vendors business with Amazon, root cause analysis of issues and opportunities affecting the vendor’s business.  
  
  
  
A day in the life  
Responsibilities Include:
  

* Lead a team of Vendor Consultants, prioritizing strategic initiatives and provide escalation support as needed.
* Success will be measured by the performance of your internal teams on input metrics and impact of vendors on creating a great customer experience.
* Identify, action and/or provide advice on how to improve business input metrics that drive growth and improve end customer experience, in collaboration with other Amazon programs and teams.
* Manage end to end goal setting for team to align with organizational goals.
* Build relationships with stakeholders across the portfolio; proactively build joint business plan action items and act as a point of escalation for outstanding issues, questions, and concerns.
* Act as a thought leader in defining success criteria and understand business needs of Selling Partners in an ever-changing business environment. Contributes to and leads strategic plans and documents for the organization.
* Leads recruiting and hiring efforts across direct team and broader organization.
* Manage stakeholders needs and monitor complexity through efficient resource allocation of Vendor Consultants.
* Monitor stakeholders satisfaction survey results to analyze both positive and negative feedback trends. Establish improvement plans and mange expectations with Vendor Consultants as appropriate.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles with a focus on data analysis experience
* Bachelor's degree
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience influencing internal and external stakeholders
* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* 2+ years of mentoring, leading and coaching experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* MBA

* 8 years of experience in product management or a related technical role.

At Google, we put our users first. The world is always changing, so we need Product Managers who are continuously adapting and excited to work on products that affect millions of people every day.
  
  
In this role, you will work cross-functionally to guide products from conception to launch by connecting the technical and business worlds. You can break down complex problems into steps that drive product development.
  
  
One of the many reasons Google consistently brings innovative, world-changing products to market is because of the collaborative work we do in Product Management. Our team works closely with creative engineers, designers, marketers, etc. to help design and develop technologies that improve access to the world's information. We're responsible for guiding products throughout the execution cycle, focusing specifically on analyzing, positioning, packaging, promoting, and tailoring our solutions to our users.

The Geo team also enables developers to use the power of Google Maps platforms to enhance their apps and websites. As they plot a course for the future of mapping, they are solving complex computer science problems, designing beautiful and intuitive product experiences, and improving our understanding of the real world.

jobs.description:
**About WorkIndia**

WorkIndia is India’s largest blue- and grey-collar hiring platform, built with a clear purpose: to provide meaningful livelihoods to 23.7 crore blue-collar individuals across India.

WorkIndia helps millions of job seekers connect with employers across the country. On the employer side, WorkIndia serves tens of thousands of businesses every month, enabling them to discover, evaluate, and hire relevant candidates at scale.

About the Product Organization

Our product teams focus on building long-term business outcomes across multiple employer journeys. Broadly, our employer-side charter spans:

* **Hunting:**
  Focuses on acquiring and converting new employers into paying customers through strong product-led growth and onboarding experiences.
* **Farming:**
  Focuses on helping existing employers succeed consistently by improving retention, expansion, and operational scalability through product systems.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a
**Product Manager with 3–5 years of experience**
to work on Employer Acquisition within the Hunting charter, owning end-to-end growth, conversion, and user experience.

You will define what to build, validate it through experimentation, and work with cross-functional stakeholders to ship impactful products.

This role requires strong execution ownership, first-principles thinking, user empathy, data fluency, and the ability to lead cross-functional teams to deliver measurable outcomes.

What You’ll Do

1. Ownership

* Own the product roadmap, driving growth, retention, UX, and funnel performance.
* Translate business goals into a clear roadmap and product priorities.
* Identify high-impact opportunities to improve conversion, activation, and user experience.
* Balance short-term execution with the long-term health of the product.

2. User Thinking & Product Judgment

* Develop a deep understanding of user needs, behaviours, and pain points.
* Ensure product decisions are grounded in real user outcomes.
* Translate user insights into scalable product improvements.
* Advocate for user impact while balancing business constraints.

3. Business & Product Leadership

* Own business outcomes for the product, not just individual features.
* Connect product decisions to measurable business impact.
* Partner with business teams to ensure product strategy reflects business goals.
* Influence cross-functional priorities and drive alignment with partner teams.

4. Execution & Systems Thinking

* Write clear PRDs with well-defined goals, scope, and success criteria.
* Design and run A/B experiments to validate major bets, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis.
* Drive high-quality execution by working closely with Engineering and Design teams through to launch.
* Identify recurring product problems and propose scalable solutions rather than one-off fixes.
* Anticipate risks and proactively adjust plans.

5. Data & Decision-Making

* Use data to drive prioritisation and product problem discovery.
* Leverage analytics and experimentation to validate hypotheses.
* Own product metrics and outcomes end-to-end.
* Distinguish meaningful business outcomes from vanity metrics.

6. Cross-Functional Leadership

* Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Customer Experience (CX), Sales, and Marketing to ship and scale products.
* Create clarity in ambiguous situations and resolve trade-offs constructively.
* Lead through influence with peers and cross-functional partners.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–5 years of Product Management experience.
* Experience in marketplace or consumer internet products is preferred.
* Proven experience designing and running end-to-end A/B experiments, including sizing, rollout percentage, and result analysis, in close collaboration with Design.
* A track record of shipping user-facing features that have delivered measurable results.
* Strong data fluency and the ability to use data for prioritisation and storytelling.
* Comfort operating in ambiguous environments.

Team & Reporting

* **Reports to:**
  Group Product Manager
* **Key Stakeholders:**
  Business, Engineering, Design, Marketing, Analytics, and Sales.

Why Join WorkIndia?

* **Impact:**
  Be part of a mission-driven company that impacts millions of lives every day.
* **Growth:**
  Work in a high-ownership environment where your initiatives directly shape the company’s growth and culture.
* **Location:**
  HSR Layout, Bangalore.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager – AspireBooks
jobs.description:
**About The Company**
Founders today are building global companies from day one — but the systems that manage their money were built for a different era. Aspire exists to change that!
  
  
We’re building the financial operating system for global founders, bringing banking, software, and automation into a single platform so businesses can move faster across borders and stay focused on building.
  
  
Aspire is built by people who think from first principles, care deeply about solving hard problems, and take real ownership of their work. Our team brings global experience from leading fintech and technology companies, and many of us are former founders and operators who understand what it takes to build thoughtfully, make trade-offs, and deliver at scale in a global environment.
  
  
Backed by leading global investors including Y Combinator, Peak XV, and Lightspeed, Aspire has been trusted by more than 50,000 startups and growing businesses worldwide to manage their finances since 2018. Together with partners like J.P. Morgan, Visa, and Wise, we’re building for the next generation of global companies.
  
  
**About The Role**
AspireBooks is Aspire's accounting product: the layer that turns Aspire from a financial operations platform into the system of record for a business's finances. It is Aspire's biggest product bet, a 0→1 accounting platform targeted to the thousands of businesses already running their finances on Aspire.
  
  
We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to take AspireBooks to mid-market customers. This is a builder-PM role: you won't just write specs, you'll ship working features yourself using AI coding tools, working inside the actual codebase alongside engineers. The role exists because mid-market accounting is won on depth and speed of execution, and we need someone who can deliver both.
  
  
You'll join a small, autonomous pod of product, design and engineering that ships at startup speed inside a scaled, profitable fintech, working daily with Engineering, Design and accounting domain experts, plus GTM teams in our key markets.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Own the mid-market roadmap for AspireBooks, from customer discovery with finance teams and accountants through to shipped features.
* Build and ship production features hands-on using AI-assisted development (Claude Code or similar), end to end.
* Write clear specs for the features the engineering pod builds, and make the build-vs-delegate call feature by feature.
* Define and track success metrics: activation, records created, reconciliation depth and retention.
* Work with Sales and CX to land mid-market customers and turn their feedback into product.
* Shape how AI agents earn the trust of accountants inside the product.

**We would love to get to know you if you have the following**

* 5+ years of product management experience, including 2+ years on B2B SaaS.
* A background in fintech or B2B SaaS serving finance teams.
* Experience with workflow-heavy B2B products: invoicing, AP/AR, payments or reporting.
* A builder-PM track record: you ship working features with AI coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor or similar), not just specs, and own discovery → delivery → code.
* Hands-on technical skills: you can read and understand code, and you implement AI in how you and your team work.

**Nice to have**

* 6+ years of product experience, including time as a lead or senior PM owning a product line end to end.
* Accounting or ERP software background (Xero, QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage, Odoo or similar), or close work with accountants and CFOs.
* Working knowledge of double-entry accounting (chart of accounts, journals, reconciliation, close), multi-entity and multi-currency, migration and onboarding flows, or accountant and partner channels.
* A former engineer or technical background; you have shipped production code in a scale-up.
* Experience with mid-market customers, not only SMB self-serve.
* Built end-to-end features solo (frontend + backend); pricing and packaging work; integration experience (bank feeds, tax engines, APIs).

**Why this role?**
Build the accounting product of the future, the way product will be built from now on. You'll be one of the first builder-PMs at Aspire: shipping code, not just decks, with the autonomy of a startup and the distribution of a platform.
  
  
**What You Get**

* Direct access to Aspire's product teams and founding team.
* An AI-native way of working, where every PM builds.
* A front-row seat on a 0→1 product inside a profitable, scaled fintech.
* Structured onboarding with engineering and accounting domain experts.

jobs.description:
**About The Role And Team**
Product at Uber means making big decisions without perfect information—and owning the outcomes. As a Senior Product Manager (Tech), you will turn massive complexity into clarity at speed, navigating the "messy" reality of multi-sided marketplaces and high-stakes technical integrations. You will be at the heart of our most ambitious missions, architecting solutions that bridge the digital and physical worlds for millions of users globally.
  
  
Our Team’s vision is to build a Global Payment Compliance Platform to support Uber’s growth and expansion, while meeting regulatory obligations. This role is also critical to enable faster scaling of Uber’s Global Business while navigating the complex and ever-changing landscape of financial regulations and compliance standards.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Define long term vision for charter with Product Leadership focused on New Opportunities and evolving landscape of Global financial regulations and User Needs.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

jobs.description:
**Summary**
Cloud Common Services (CCS) builds the essential cloud infrastructure and platform services that power the Guidewire Cloud Platform (GWCP). At the heart of this is Atmos, Guidewire's "PaaS within SaaS" layer — built on AWS, Kubernetes, and Docker — that automates the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized core applications, cloud-native services, and associated workloads.
  
  
As Platform Product Manager, you'll own the roadmap and delivery for a defined set of platform capabilities within CCS/Atmos that internal engineering teams and external insurer customers rely on every day. Working closely with senior product leaders, engineering, and SRE, you'll help shape how Guidewire delivers infrastructure as a product — with a focus on developer experience, reliability, security, and cost efficiency.
  
  
This role is a strong fit for someone with a solid technical foundation in cloud infrastructure who is building their product management career and wants to grow into platform strategy ownership.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for candidates with 6–10 years of overall work experience, including a minimum of 1–2 years in Product Management (or a product-adjacent role such as technical program management, solutions engineering, or platform engineering with product responsibilities).
  
  

* Own the roadmap and backlog for one or more platform service areas within CCS/Atmos — such as deployment tooling, observability, Kubernetes-based compute, networking, or shared platform services — in alignment with the broader CCS product strategy.

* Write clear feature requirements and user stories with well-defined use cases and acceptance criteria.

* Communicate progress, trade-offs, and outcomes clearly to engineering teams and stakeholders.
* Embrace a culture of curiosity, innovation, and responsible use of AI — using emerging tools and data-driven insights to improve how you and your teams work.

We're looking for someone who
  
  

* Has experience working on platform, infrastructure, or developer-facing products — as a product manager, or in a technical role (engineering, SRE, DevOps, solutions/technical program management) with a demonstrated interest in moving into product management.
* Has a solid understanding of AWS services and cloud-native architectures (AWS Cloud Practitioner certification is a plus).

* Collaborates effectively with engineering and operations teams through design, development, testing, release, and maintenance.
* Uses data and customer feedback to inform decisions and measure outcomes.
* Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Is eager to learn, take ownership, and grow into broader product strategy responsibilities.

Nice to have
  
  

* Exposure to identity and access management concepts — SAML, OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SSO, SCIM — and how they apply to platform services.
* Experience with load balancing and networking in cloud environments.
* AWS Cloud Practitioner (or higher) certification.
* Familiarity with Aha! and JIRA.
* Prior experience in a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
* Ability to travel up to 5% as needed.

Role-specific competencies
  
  

* Customer Need: Comfortable engaging with internal developer teams and external customers to understand their needs and document use cases.
* Product Execution: Ability to turn prioritized needs into well-specified, deliverable increments and see them through to launch.
* Collaboration: Works well across cross-functional teams and builds trust with engineering partners.
* Results Driven: Tracks adoption and outcomes, learns from data, and iterates.
* Communication: Able to explain both the technical detail and business value of platform work to the appropriate audience.
* Motivation: A genuine interest in the craft of product management and in platform/infrastructure as a product.

**About Guidewire**
Guidewire is the platform P&C insurers trust to engage, innovate, and grow efficiently. We combine digital, core, analytics, and AI to deliver our platform as a cloud service. More than 540+ insurers in 40 countries, from new ventures to the largest and most complex in the world, run on Guidewire.

jobs.description:
Business Introduction  
GSK remains committed to achieving bold commercial ambitions for the future. By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.  
Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.  
Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges.  
  
**Job Purpose**

The Product Owner owns the backlog and roadmap for GSK's network segmentation product, translating what GSK teams need into prioritised work and maximising the value the platform delivers to the teams that consume it. The role works daily with engineering to deliver increments and accept completed work, links every backlog item to strategy and OKRs, and measures adoption and outcome rather than output.

The role sits inside the platform team and holds genuine product decision rights over backlog order and acceptance. Platform strategy and the multi-year roadmap sit with the Platform Manager, domain demand and sequencing sit with the Domain Portfolio Manager, technical design and standards sit with the Platform Architect, and the reliability bar sits with Reliability Engineering.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own and prioritise the product backlog by value, risk and reliability, applying lean portfolio principles rather than fixed project plans.

jobs.title: Senior Team Lead
jobs.description:
**Who we are**

Born in 2014, Yoti is a digital identity and biometric technology company that makes it safer for people to prove who they are. The Yoti app was designed with privacy at its core, giving people a secure way to prove their identity and share third-party credentials with organisations and other people.

Today, we have over twenty million app downloads around the world. We’ve expanded our offering to a suite of business solutions that span identity verification, age verification and estimation, e-signing, AI anti-spoofing technologies and we continue to think of innovative new offerings.

From day one, we’ve been working to fix an outdated identity system. This is not a journey we make on our own but with policy advisors, think tanks, researchers, academics, humanitarian bodies, our users and everyday people. We are committed to solving identity problems through grassroots research and social purpose initiatives.

Our dedication to our mission and our team is why Yoti was proudly named one of the Sunday Times Best Places to Work 2026 in the UK.

**About the role**

You will manage two squads of 5-7 engineers, delivering across several Yoti products. There are a number of additional critical responsibilities aside from general engineering management.

The first is security. You own secure by design practice for the services your teams run: threat models, review discipline, dependency and secrets hygiene, and the unglamorous work of closing findings before an auditor asks about them.

The second is AI, and we mean something specific by it. This is not a role about training models. It is about how software gets built here. We are standardising on an AI native SDLC, and we are building it now.

We measure outcomes and we expect a Senior Team Lead to have a view on what should be built and how much of it, not just how fast it can ship. If a spec asks for six months of work to reach a result you could test in three weeks, we want you to say so before our time investment.

**What AI native means here**

Our engineers work with coding agents daily, mostly Claude Code, and the standard is written to work across Codex and Copilot too. Three things sit underneath it:

* Work is spec driven. A change is described as a spec before it is built, and a verification gate scores that spec and checks it against a short engineering constitution before anyone starts implementing.
* Capabilities are skills, not prompts people keep in a scratch file. Commands and agents are committed as SKILL.md files in a shared repository, so a skill written once works in every assistant the team uses.
* Context is shared, not copied. Project context lives in AGENTS.md and company knowledge lives in one knowledge repository that both humans and agents read.

So thinking in agents and skills is a real part of the job. When a task keeps recurring, the answer is usually a skill in the shared repository or a variant of an existing one, not another private workflow that nobody else can find.

**What you'll do**

**Lead the teams**

* Manage a team lead and engineers across two squads: hiring, onboarding, growth, performance and retention.
* Coach and develop team leads and engineers, and build the bench beneath you.
* Set how the teams work day to day, including planning, review, on call and postmortems.
* Make it safe to raise a security concern or say an agent's output is wrong, even when it slows a release down.

**Scope and ship products**

* Partner with product managers as a peer. Push back on scope, propose smaller versions that answer the same question, and know which requirements really matter.
* Hold the teams to the outcome behind the work. Be able to say what a release was supposed to change for a customer, and whether it did.
* Own delivery end to end for your squads: scope, sequencing, dependencies, quality and a release cadence people can plan around.
* Arbitrate between products competing for the same shared platform work, and be honest with everyone about the trade offs.
* Keep reliability, security and compliance work funded alongside features instead of parked behind them.
* Represent your teams to stakeholders in the UK and other Yoti locations, and to customers when it helps.

**Own security engineering**

* Make threat modelling, secure review, dependency and supply chain management, secrets handling and least privilege access normal practice rather than a checklist.
* Drive remediation from penetration tests, bug bounty reports and internal reviews, with named owners and dates.
* Lead your teams' part in incident response, including out of hours escalation and postmortems that name causes rather than people.
* Treat biometric and identity data with the retention and minimisation discipline it needs.

**What we're looking for**

**Essential**

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Substantial engineering management experience, typically 7 years or more, including managing senior engineers or tech leads, on top of a strong hands on background.
* Building or scaling an engineering team in India inside a globally distributed company.
* Salesforce experience, working with it or on it directly
* Experience with one or more of the following languages, Javascript, Typescript, Golang or Apex
* Experience with postgres
* A Harness experience like claude code, codex or Cursor.
* Experience running more than one team or workstream at once, across multiple products.
* You use a coding agent daily and have opinions about it. You can say what you delegate, what you read line by line, and where agents reliably let you down.
* You have built reusable AI capability, not just had good chats: skills, subagents, prompts or tooling that other people went on to use.
* A real track record of shipping and running secure production software. You can talk about threat models you wrote, findings you prioritised and incidents you led.
* A product instinct. You have shaped scope, cut features that were not e…

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
**Who are we?**  
  

Myntra is India’s leading fashion and lifestyle platform, where technology meets creativity. As pioneers in fashion e-commerce, we’ve always believed in disrupting the ordinary.

We thrive on a shared passion for fashion, a drive to innovate to lead, and an environment that empowers each one of us to pave our own way. We’re bold in our thinking, agile in our execution, and collaborative in spirit.
  
Here, we create MAGIC by inspiring vibrant and joyous self-expression and expanding fashion possibilities for India, while staying true to what we believe in.

We believe in taking bold bets and changing the fashion landscape of India. We are a company that is constantly evolving into newer and better forms and we look for people who are ready to evolve with us.
  
From our humble beginnings as a customization company in 2007 to being technology and fashion pioneers today, Myntra is going places and we want you to take part in this journey with us.

Working at Myntra is challenging but fun - we are a young and dynamic team, firm believers in meritocracy, believe in equal opportunity, encourage intellectual curiosity and empower our teams with the right tools, space, and opportunities.

  

The Role
  
The Customer Experience (CX) charter at Myntra is dedicated to removing friction from the user journey—from app launch to post-delivery support. As a Data Analyst for the CX team, you will be the analytical engine driving our understanding of customer behavior, pain points, and satisfaction metrics. You will translate complex datasets into clear, actionable strategies that directly influence product roadmaps and business operations.
  
Key Responsibilities
  

* **Data Analytics and Insights:** Dive deep into customer interaction data (NPS, CSAT, app drop-offs, and support tickets) to identify root causes of customer friction. Translate raw data into actionable insights that guide CX improvements.
* **Predictive Trend Analysis:** Build models to forecast customer behavior, return rates, and seasonal ticket volumes. Anticipate CX challenges before they occur to help operations and product teams stay ahead of the curve.
* **Visual Intelligence:** Design and maintain intuitive, high-impact dashboards (via Tableau, PowerBI, or Looker) that track core CX metrics. Make complex data easily consumable for leadership and cross-functional teams.
* **Market Intelligence:** Monitor industry benchmarks and competitor CX strategies. Identify gaps and opportunities to ensure Myntra remains the gold standard for e-commerce customer experience in India.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Act as the primary data partner for CX leaders. Effectively communicate findings, influence strategic decisions, and align analytical outputs with operational realities.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:** Partner seamlessly with Product, Engineering, Supply Chain, and Customer Support teams to deploy data-backed solutions and track the efficacy of new feature rollouts.

Required Skills & Qualifications
  
We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates a strong baseline (minimum 2 years of applied experience or a solid Level 2 proficiency) across the following core competencies:
  

* **Data Analytics and Insights (2):** Proficiency in SQL, Python/R, and advanced Excel. Strong ability to extract, clean, and interpret large datasets to solve ambiguous problems.
* **Visual Intelligence (2):** Hands-on experience with BI tools. Ability to design dashboards that tell a compelling story rather than just displaying numbers.
* **Predictive Trend Analysis (2):** Experience working with statistical methods, forecasting, and basic machine learning concepts to predict customer trends.
* **Market Intelligence (2):** Familiarity with e-commerce market dynamics, consumer behavior research, and competitive benchmarking.
* **Business Acumen (2):** Strong understanding of how CX metrics (like retention and lifetime value) directly impact the bottom line. Ability to balance customer delight with business profitability.
* **Stakeholder Management (2) & Collaboration (2):** Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Proven ability to translate technical findings for non-technical audiences and drive alignment across diverse teams.

Cisco’s Global Supplier Management (GSM) organization is a highly experienced, cross-functional team that drives sourcing and costing processes, supports supply continuity, and develops commodity strategies across a broad portfolio of Cisco products. The team works closely with component suppliers to improve innovation, productivity, and operational efficiency.
  
  
As a Business Analyst on the Cost Operations team, you will play a key role in supporting end-to-end cost processes and enabling commodity teams to make smarter, faster business decisions through analytics, process discipline, and digital transformation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**  

* Support cost processes through supplier RFQ management, including costing and quoting activities for assigned commodities, quote analysis, and quote closure support

* Perform cost and sourcing analytics, including scenario planning, variance analysis, and data-driven insights to identify gaps and address business challenges
* Apply predictive and analytical methods to anticipate pricing trends and potential supply risks within the quote cycle
* Build and maintain actionable dashboards in Power BI or Tableau to track cost operations metrics for senior leadership
* Partner closely with commodity managers, supply chain teams, suppliers, and manufacturing partners across a global environment

Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering, Business Analytics, Finance, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.

* Working knowledge or project-based experience developing dashboards and reports in Power BI or Tableau.

Preferred Qualifications

Who You Are

You are comfortable translating complex information into clear insights, identifying risks early, and driving disciplined execution. You are also curious about how AI and automation can simplify work, improve insight generation, and strengthen business processes.

Bengaluru, India
  
  
**Your impact begins here**
As Lead Business Analyst, you will be the primary bridge between Commercial, Medical and Customer Engagement stakeholders and IT delivery teams. You will lead requirements management, business process optimisation, solution design and stakeholder alignment, turning business needs into compliant, scalable capabilities across Veeva Vault CRM, Salesforce, marketing automation and connected engagement platforms. Your impact shows up in stronger healthcare professional (HCP) engagement, better field force effectiveness and a sharper customer experience.
  
  
**What You’ll Bring**
You know the pharmaceutical commercial landscape, you are confident in Agile delivery and you enjoy bringing business and IT to a clear, shared answer.
  
  

* At least 5 years of hands-on Business Analyst experience in the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry, with a track record of delivering technology-enabled business capabilities.
* Strong business acumen across Sales, Medical Affairs, Key Account Management (KAM), Marketing, Compliance and Content Management, and the ability to translate business needs into scalable digital capabilities.
* Strong ability to translate business needs into epics, features, user stories, detailed acceptance criteria, process flows and functional specifications within Agile delivery frameworks.
* Hands-on Agile and hybrid delivery experience, including backlog grooming, release planning, acceptance testing to determine whether it meets its business requirements, user needs, and design specifications before being approved for production deployment or customer handoff and change management.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to engage stakeholders across business and IT, explain technical concepts plainly and build alignment.
* Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT), defect triage, training and business adoption.
* Understanding of pharmaceutical regulatory, validation and data privacy requirements, and a safe, ethical approach to AI.
* A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Pharmacy or a related discipline.

**Useful, But Not Essential**

* Hands-on experience with Veeva Vault CRM, Salesforce, marketing automation or similar customer engagement platforms, plus familiarity with data, analytics and system integration landscapes.

**What You’ll Do**
You will lead requirements and backlog grooming for customer engagement capabilities, working within the governance set by Product Management, Business Owners and Enterprise IT leadership.
  
  

* Act as the bridge between business stakeholders and IT delivery teams, leading requirements elicitation and translating needs into clear, testable epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows and functional specifications.
* Define, refine and prioritise the product backlog with Product Owners, and facilitate decisions on scope and priorities so delivery keeps moving.
* Optimise business processes by identifying root causes, risks and dependencies, and recommend solution designs based on business value, feasibility and compliance.
* Ensure traceability from business objectives through design, development, testing and deployment, and govern the quality of requirements throughout.
* Coordinate release planning, testing and UAT with architects, developers and QA, and lead change management, training and adoption so new capabilities are used in real life.

**Who You’ll Work With**
In Enterprise IT & Quality, colleagues work across the full Novo value chain, staying close to stakeholders in the business and helping deliver high quality, trusted technology and environmentally responsible ways of working.
  
  
You will join Customer Engagement Technologies (CET), part of Enterprise IT – Veeva & Ecosystem. CET drives the strategy, development and delivery of connected, data-driven commercial capabilities, partnering with Customer Engagement and Medical stakeholders to orchestrate HCP engagement and support data-informed decisions.
  
  
Your closest partners will be Product Managers, Product Owners, Solution Architects, developers, QA and operations teams. You will also work with International Operations affiliates and end users, Global Business Services, Novo management.
  
  
These relationships are where the role creates momentum: you bring clarity when priorities compete, speak up when things stall, and help business and IT decide, own it and follow through.
  
  
**What You Can Expect Here**
You will be trusted to work with a high degree of independence and to make your voice heard in decisions that shape products used across markets. Working across commercial, medical and technology teams, you will broaden your perspective and build new skills on the job and through relevant learning offerings.
  
  
As Novo upskills its entire workforce to advance AI as a driver of innovation, you can apply new technology responsibly in your daily work. Expectations are clear, results are recognised and honest feedback helps everyone raise the bar.
  
  
**Start now**
Your impact begins today. If you are ready to turn business needs into connected, compliant capabilities that help Novo engage healthcare professionals better, apply for the Lead Business Analyst role by 9 Nov 2026.
  
  
We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
